note: Moldova: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days in any 180; citizens of other countries may apply for an e-Visa (up to 20 days' processing), those of most African Union states and others with an invitation from the General Inspectorate for Migration first (not modelled apart). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and European Integration's own lists of the foreigners who need a visa and those exempted: the exempt list names every passport held as free (no length given); its 'Dominican Republic', between Denmark and Greece, is taken as Dominica, since the Dominican Republic is on the Ministry's other list, of those who need a visa. The 90 days and the e-Visa stand on Wikipedia's copy.
